items.text: Francesco's Law signed — guns must be kept in a locked storage container when not in use, with tougher penalties if minors or unlicensed people get access.
Ammo background checks expanded — purchases now blocked for anyone barred from owning rifles/shotguns or under a temporary or extreme risk protection order.
NRA, SAF & FPC sue in federal court (W.D.N.Y.) over NY's "convertible pistol" law — Firing Pin, LLC v. James.
State budget signed: new handguns sold in NY must be designed so they can't be easily converted into machine guns (Glock-style pistols targeted).
3D printers sold in NY must include software that blocks printing guns and gun parts; a state task force will set the standards.
U.S. Supreme Court declined to hear the CCIA challenge (Antonyuk) — NY's sensitive-place carry restrictions remain in effect.
